|quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Ambush''' is a [[movement]] spell that causes the player to teleport to an enemy, [[blind]]ing them and causing your next one-handed melee attack to be exerted, gaining a large boost to [[critical strike]] chance and multiplier. ==Skill functions and interactions== * Ambush can be used regardless of the weapon equipped, as long as there is a nearby enemy. * Only melee attacks with one-handed weapons are able to be exerted, providing a large amount of critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier for the exerted attack. [[Unarmed]] attacks and [[shield]] attacks cannot be exerted by Ambush. * Ways to reduce the cooldown of Ambush are the [[Fleetfoot]] and [[Mysticism]] passive clusters. One of the two [[Ambush#Related_helmet_enchantments|helmet enchant]] in the permanent league. [[Ritual]]s base type {{il|Dreamquest Slippers}}, [[Experimented_base_type|Heist experimented base types]] {{il|Infernal Blade}}, or [[Modifier:TravelSkillCooldownRecoveryEldritchImplicit1|Eater of the world implict]] on boots. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Critical
Multiplier |c1_header = Exerted Attacks have +x% to Critical Strike Multiplier |c1_pattern_extract = Exerted Attacks have %+(%d+)%% to Critical Strike Multiplier |c1_pattern_value = +%d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Quality now causes Exerted Attacks to have +0-10% to Critical Strike Chance, instead of providing 0-10% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Ambush no longer has “Exerted Attacks have 200-276% increased Critical Strike Chance”. Instead, it now has “Exerted Attacks have +25% to Critical Strike Chance”. * Quality on the Divergent Ambush Skill now grants “Exerted Attacks have +0-5% to Critical Strike Chance” (previously “Exerted Attacks have 0-40% increased Critical Strike Chance”). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Ambush has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
